plink2/real/keep48.samples.txt.transformation: First 48 unchanged sample identifiers, in source order; an explicit bounded test subset.

plink2/real/scores.tsv.transformation: Choose 20 variants with greatest ALT allele count, source order breaks ties. Assign arbitrary coefficient ((rank % 7)-3)/8. Synthetic software-test coefficients, not measured effects or a clinical score.

plink2/synthetic/glm-missing/covariates..transformation: Upstream two-covariate formulas and seed 7, with explicit LCG replacing awk rand; entirely synthetic.

plink2/synthetic/glm-missing/input.vcf.transformation: Synthetic adaptation: retain upstream 603 samples, 30 variants and exact alternating missingness formula. Replace PLINK --dummy and implementation-dependent awk rand with the explicit upstream LCG (seed 3), common-allele frequencies 0.12+0.36*U and two Bernoulli allele draws per genotype.

plink2/synthetic/glm-missing/phenotypes..transformation: BINARY uses upstream 0.4 case probability, LCG seed 11 replacing awk rand. QUANT is independent 4*U-2 (seed19). FIRTH is intentionally 2 for v1 ALT carriers, 1 otherwise to force separation. All labels synthetic; no biological association claim.

plink2/synthetic/haploid.psam.transformation: Exact contents of upstream printf-generated synthetic sex table.

plink2/synthetic/haploid.vcf.transformation: Unchanged bytes of the named literal VCF here-document; synthetic upstream regression input.

plink2/synthetic/multiallelic.vcf.transformation: Unchanged bytes of the named literal VCF here-document; synthetic upstream regression input.

plink2/synthetic/phased-multiallelic.vcf.transformation: First upstream Python generator reproduced with identical PRNG, sample counts and genotype formulas. Contig length metadata changed from 1000 to 100000000; genotype and variant records unchanged.

plink2/synthetic/score-dosage/input.vcf.transformation: Upstream sample/variant counts, rare/common allele, missingness, dosage and haploid formulas, with explicit LCG replacing implementation-dependent awk rand; same seeds 17/18. Synthetic regression data.

plink2/synthetic/score-dosage/scores.tsv.transformation: Upstream score formulas and seed 5, LCG replacing awk rand; header added. Synthetic arbitrary coefficients.

plink2/synthetic/score-dosage/sex.tsv.transformation: All synthetic samples assigned male as upstream dosage test requires; supplied in both sets for consistent import.

plink2/synthetic/score-hardcall/input.vc.transformation: Upstream sample/variant counts, rare/common allele, missingness, dosage and haploid formulas, with explicit LCG replacing implementation-dependent awk rand; same seeds 17/18. Synthetic regression data.

plink2/synthetic/score-hardcall/scores.t.transformation: Upstream score formulas and seed 5, LCG replacing awk rand; header added. Synthetic arbitrary coefficients.

plink2/synthetic/score-hardcall/sex.tsv.transformation: All synthetic samples assigned male as upstream dosage test requires; supplied in both sets for consistent import.
